surface.use: Code blocks, command boxes and panels.

ink.use: Main text, Signs and Class stamps.

ink-muted.use: Secondary prose, such as the paragraph under a title.

dim.use: Subtitles, meta, labels and secondary links.

rule-strong.use: Link underlines, hover borders, selection and scrollbars.

keyword.use: `import`, `from`, `const`, `export`, `as` and operators; JSX attributes; a code block's file name.

function.use: Function calls and declarations; HTML tags and attributes; the first token of a shell command (`pnpm`).

string.use: Strings; the arguments of a shell command (`init`, package names).

comment.use: Comments; a code block's language label.

mono.use: Code, commands, URLs, package and executable names, labels and meta.
